correctness.rationale: For a fixed largest shift c, 3-pseudoperiodicity is exactly the local condition x[0] in {x[a],x[b],x[c]} on every length-(c+1) factor. The published factor complexity p(m)=2m+1 certifies factor-list completeness once the generated prefix contains exactly that many factors. The package verifies this for every m<=504 and exhausts every 1<=a<b<c<504 with an exact mismatch-bitset criterion. A separate direct-string pass rechecks every one of the 9352 stored survivors against the complete relevant factor set, and all reported cumulative counts are recomputed.

value.rationale: The source explicitly identifies complete Tribonacci 3-pseudoperiod characterization as an open computational problem and says its intended automaton route was beyond available resources. A complete classification through the canonical substitution length |sigma^10(0)|=504 is therefore a mathematically motivated finite boundary, not an arbitrary slice. The census expands the single published witness to 9352 certified triples and supplies a reproducible exact initial region for testing any future automaton or structural conjecture.
